custody.consumed_fixture_source: NKR-11 deterministic 12-world synthetic engineering fixture; no original science

objective: Build the smallest opt-in native 16-slot (7 active, 9 retained) checkpoint bank that simultaneously preserves already qualified NKR-11 public action-consequence causal signatures across sequential interference and a process-cold restore, without any change to the original native numerical learner, original 16-cell PublicCausalCells counter state, accepted model, or actual control loop.

mechanism.native: Immutable NativeCumulativeActionBank wrapper storing up to 16 existing NativeInterventionRepair instances by explicit PublicCausalCells native address; each existing instance contains one 32-event warm historical action model and at most one 16-event contradiction-triggered repair. No state is moved or overwritten across native addresses. The bank is a coordination/retention interface, not a new fitter or automatic identity discovery.
mechanism.public_interface: Only explicitly supplied native address and already source-pinned public NKR-11 warm/repair bundles are accepted. Knowledge-address selection is supplied; therefore do NOT claim autonomous discovery of task identity or cue routing.
mechanism.source_evidence: Canonical NKR-11 public event bundle SHA and source IDs; enforce unique warm/repair source-id and record-ref custody globally across all bank slots, including on restoration. Refuse invalid source kind, private truth, direct source URL, forged SHA, repeated source identity or cross-slot rebind.
mechanism.atomicity: Every install/repair returns a fresh bank, never modifies source bank, and validates all proposed evidence/cost before accepting it; duplicate same-slot repair returns same bank/no effect via existing NKR-11 semantics.
mechanism.cold: Bounded canonical UTF-8 ASCII JSON with SHA256 integrity, versioned schema, sorted 16-slot records with typed slot ids, per-member exact checkpoint hash, whole-bank checksum, and round-trip byte identity. Restore using each existing NKR-11 model's official SHA validator; tamper -> fail closed.
mechanism.compatibility: Preserve original PublicCausalCells 164-byte checkpoint; do not alter yggdrasil/native_intervention_repair.py or its public fit/predict/receipt interface.
mechanism.truth_scope: Existing exposed NKR-11 fixture-only deterministic action consequences; source oracle is evaluator-only, never imported by new native bank.

controls.matched_reference: Exact unmodified 12 separate NKR-11 NativeInterventionRepair models in a dictionary with the same public per-slot labels, data, cold checkpoint and replay; expected equal correctness and no gain in learned cognition.
controls.negative_erase: A no-storage bank abstains on returns after interference; this is a negative memory ablation only.
controls.negative_collision: Cross-slot source id reuse, forged checkpoint, wrong address/retained flag, duplicate slot install, overcapacity, ambiguous/unsupported public evidence, and any attempt to change NKR-11 scientific_pass or native_accepted flags must be rejected.
controls.no_strong_science_claim: Previous NKR-11 full 1,024-program independently enumerated symbolic solver already tied 192/192; this gate cannot claim superiority or SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

gate.comparison: No absolute latency threshold because retention-bank feature is an engineering interface, not performance-science proposal. Report measured checkpoint size and wall time without claiming speed gain.
gate.classification: ENGINEERING_DEV_PASS if all source-only frozen gates PASS, else ENGINEERING_NO_GO; scientific always UNVERIFIED / native accepted false.
gate.full_regression: Required exact-source final G29 & complete inherited Python tests + new focused tests on Ubuntu/Windows before qualified engineering PR; separate native application integration/build must remain unverified unless actually run.

only_paths: three generated .ice/code-atlas.* only after separate qualification
